name: LiaScript code fences in Markdown
injectionSelector: L:text.html.markdown - text.html.markdown.liascript - markup.raw - markup.fenced_code - meta.embedded - source - comment - string - meta.fenced-code.liascript

patterns.name: meta.fenced-code.liascript
patterns.comment: Only quoted macro annotations need a Markdown repair. Respect Markdown indentation so the first line of an indented code example remains literal. The nested fence owns subsequent lines until its closing delimiter.

comment: Recognize LiaScript macro annotations in Markdown without switching the language mode. Ordinary prose and code examples keep their Markdown grammar.
